in_arabic.name: أسيلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: Aseela is derived from the Arabic word 'Sila', which means 'path' or 'way'. The name Aseela is a feminine variant of the name Asil, which means 'pure, sincere, or faithful'. The name Aseela is believed to convey the idea of someone who is faithful to their path or way of life.
